integrity: Exact finite-state assertions were independently replayed from the included checker; analytic limits are proved and finite tests are not represented as proof of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to uniform-win simple sticky random walks initialized with m-k one-card and k two-card active players; asymptotic laws assume k/m tends to a positive constant or k=o(m). The rare tail holds at each fixed positive diffusive time, not uniformly at zero; no rates are claimed. Similar work may have unknown historical priority.
title: Exact absorption laws and rare diffusive tails for near-critical simple sticky walks
